critique_changes: Concept rebuilt around the batch label on each jar: Jar weights, harvest months and origin are the facts buyers ask about, and they already read like a printed label.
Bold move moved to a harvest calendar band: Twelve months with each honey's harvest marked is the one thing only this subject has.
Palette taken from wax paper, propolis and amber honey: Replaces the generic cream and terracotta; muted text now passes contrast.
Display face changed to Zilla Slab, body to Source Sans 3: A slab reads like stamped crate labels; Inter was a default.
Left aligned label column, hero sized to content, no motion: Centered 100vh and scroll fades were defaults and hid content at rest.

findings_before_repair.message: page scrolls sideways: content is 740px wide in a 390px viewport

issues.problem: On the 390px screenshots the harvest table runs past the right edge and the whole page scrolls sideways, which the report confirms.
issues.fix: Wrap the table in a div with overflow-x: auto so only the table scrolls, and give that container a label and tabindex so keyboard users can scroll it.

review.notes: The label concept and the harvest band come through clearly in both themes; the only real problem is the table on phones.
